subject: BrightOps hosted-rate deep-dive & parity ask
messages:
From: Alex Dunn <alex@brightops.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing / competitor parity request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking a look. We ran a quick vendor price comparison and are evaluating options for BrightOps' new assistant (customer support automation + summarization). We're seeing the following blended numbers from vendors (monthly estimate ~1.2B tokens):

- OpenAI (gpt-4o-instruct / embeddings): generation ~ $0.025 / 1k tokens, embeddings ~ $0.005 / 1k tokens
- Anthropic (Claude-Next): generation ~ $0.02 / 1k tokens
- Together (Open models): generation ~ $0.015 / 1k tokens but higher infra variance
- AWS Bedrock (custom): comparable to Anthropic once you add EKS costs

BrightOps is interested in Redwood but the procurement team needs a baseline hosted API rate and any ability to match or be within parity of these vendors for committed volumes. Attached is our rate request + usage profile (BrightOps_RateRequest_0818.pdf). Can you provide:

1) Baseline hosted API rates (generation + embeddings) for a standard subscription vs committed (12mo)
2) Any matching/discount options for committed volume or reserved capacity
3) Notes on functional differences we should call out vs the vendors above (latency SLOs, model variants, streaming, embeddings quality)

Also looping in procurement (Priya). Ideally we'd have a short call next week to review.

Best,
Alex Dunn
Head of Platform Partnerships
BrightOps

Alex — thanks for the clear profile and the attachment. I can get you a clean baseline and a committed-volume proposal, and will coordinate with our pricing team. A few quick clarifying Qs that will help speed the quote:

- Is the 1.2B tokens/month steady-state or a peak month?
- Embeddings footprint: are you using single-vector per doc or multi-vector (we see a ~1.8x uplift for multi-vector usage)
- Are you planning to use streaming generation in production (low-latency assistant) or batch calls (async jobs)?

If you can confirm those three, I’ll loop in Ben and Marissa for the match conversation and have a proposed sheet back to you in 48 business hours. Happy to set a 30-min call next Tue/Wed.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Naomi / team — scope reviewed. Draft proposal and rationale below. I built two tiers: baseline (self-serve hosted) and committed 12-mo parity program. Numbers are per 1k tokens (generation) and per 1k vectors for embeddings. Assumptions: 1.2B tokens steady-state monthly, embeddings ~200M vectors/month, USD, US region.

Proposal (generation / embeddings):
- Baseline hosted (no commit): $0.028 / 1k tokens (generation), $0.0065 / 1k vectors (embeddings)
- Committed 12-mo (volume commit >= 12B tokens total over term): $0.0175 / 1k tokens, $0.0035 / 1k vectors

Competitor parity notes: we can match or beat Together on list-level generation price with the committed tier, and come within ~10–15% of Anthropic for embeddings. OpenAI's public list is lower at some points but recall our SLO (100ms median on streaming), model-variant matrix, prefix/KV caching, and dedicated support for rollout patterns. For BrightOps I recommend pushing the committed tier with a 3-month ramp: 20% month1, 50% month2, 100% month3. We should require a minimum annual spend floor (USD $80k/mo equivalent) to enable these discounts.

Commercials and guardrails:
- 12-mo term, net-30 invoice, 30-day termination for material breach only
- Volume true-up quarterly; overages billed at committed tier rate
- If BrightOps reduces committed volumes by >25% vs forecast, we reserve right to reprice to baseline after 60 days
- One-time onboarding credit: $25k for migrations + batch-import credits (applies to first invoice)

Next steps:
1) Naomi to confirm acceptance of the ramp + spend floor to the customer
2) If customer agrees, prepare SOW and DocuSign (I’ll draft with legal).

Link to draft rate sheet: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3Cq-Redwood-CompMatrix
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/BR-2027-412

Ben Carter

Alex / Priya — thanks for the packet. We reviewed internally and can offer the committed 12-month parity program subject to the following (short summary):

- Committed 12-mo pricing: $0.0175 / 1k tokens (generation), $0.0035 / 1k vectors (embeddings) for the agreed profile (1.2B tokens/mo, ~200M vectors/mo)
- Ramp schedule: 20% / 50% / 100% over the first 3 months; quarterly true-ups
- Minimum spend floor: equivalent to $80k/month (annualized) to enable discounting
- Onboarding credit: $25k applied to first invoice
- Required: signed MSA + volume SOW and DocuSign within 14 days of LOI; legal review likely 5–7 business days

We believe this brings Redwood within parity of the vendors you listed on committed economics while offering stronger production SLOs, integrated rollout tooling, and built-in KV/prefix caching that should reduce your token burn for certain flows.

If that looks good, can we lock a 30-min call Wed 8/25 at 10am PT to finalize SOW items and timeline? I’ve copied Ben and Marissa to move DocuSign + SOW drafts.

Best,
